no_condition.why: NO BAR EXISTS ANYWHERE IN THE PLAY. The trigger is 'when sizing the expected dominant-move magnitude', which is every day; the read is the blind's own per-day magnitude error; and the call is an explicit instruction NOT to act ('CANDIDATE correction ONLY... Do NOT globally rescale', deferring the actual sort to magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort). The play's own health field reaches the same conclusion in its own words: 'there is no numeric bar... it never selects a subset of days, and it never emits a number.' The only figures in the record are five realized guess-vs-actual pairs (1008 +320/-1980, 1010 +150/-1490, 1016 -300/-1190, 1020 +580/+2770, 1021 +440/+1100) - OUTCOMES logged after the fact, not a quantity readable at the open. A residual log is not a condition, and the audit further shows two of the five are wrong-SIGN days, so they do not even measure scale. Writing any bar here would be pure manufacture.

OPERANDS UNSERVED AND NO THRESHOLD WRITTEN - both disqualifiers hold independently. The read is 'the running (roll-clean) path at a cum-EXTREME + a counter-move in the old swing's LAST 1-2 days + last-hour momentum into the seam'. All three are price-path content and none appears in the vocabulary: I searched it for cum_, last_hour, close_off, retrace and swing/chain age and there is no such path. The nearest-looking candidates are vol_regime.n0_prev_net and n0_net_sigma_5/10/20, and naming either would be the hole-#8 error twice over: (a) a prior-session net is a different quantity from a close measured against a running extreme, and (b) I checked the served values - vol_regime carries masked_one_shot true and is FROZEN at the block-anchor vintage, so n0_prev_date reads 2026-06-19 and n0_prev_net reads -80 on all ten days of G22 alike. It is constant by construction, i.e. degenerate before it is even mis-scoped. Separately the play states no number at all: 'a stretched swing' and 'cum-extreme' are qualitative, so even a served operand would have no bar to attach to. Its health field records the consequence: 0 fires in 60 days across G17-G23.

THE BARS ARE REAL AND BOTH OPERANDS ARE UNSERVED. The trigger carries two genuine numeric bars - swing AGE (<=3 young / >=4 mature, counted in sessions since the swing turned) and materiality of '>= ~$300 beyond the prior extreme close'. Neither quantity exists in the vocabulary. There is no swing-age or chain-age path (squeeze_watch.sessions_since_prompt_expiry counts sessions since a CONTRACT expiry, a different clock; the cot/storage/steo *.age_days fields are data staleness), and no close-versus-running-extreme path. vol_regime.n0_prev_net cannot carry the $300 bar: it is a session NET, not a close measured against the running extreme, and in the blind state it is frozen at the anchor vintage and constant across the block. The play's health field says the same from the other side - C stands it down on G20 0525/0603, G22 0624/0630/0701 and G23 0707 because 'chain age and cum-from-anchor are price content the mask removes'. NOTE ON THE ONE SERVED-LOOKING ARM: the s101_6_expiry_day_form sub-arm in legacy_notes turns on expiry proximity (served as flow_calendar.days_to_futures_expiry / days_to_opex) and on stranded premium (contract_structure.calendar_front_next_spread). I deliberately did not curate it: no threshold is written for 'stranded premium absent' - E-0626 judged -0.043 to be absent by eye - and the arm's own brain_action assigns it to structure.squeeze_unwind, not to this play's trigger. Curating it would be inventing a bar and attaching it to the wrong play.

THE BAR IS REAL AND BOTH OPERANDS ARE UNSERVED. The bar is a retrace FRACTION of the swing (>=~75%, softened to >=~70%) measured against the swing's ORIGIN SHELF PRICE. Neither is in the vocabulary: no retrace fraction, no cum-from-anchor, no swing-origin level. The vocabulary does now serve price LEVELS - options_surface.months[i].top5_oi_strikes[j].strike and oi_weighted_strike, newly visible as indexed paths - and I rejected them explicitly: an open-interest pin strike is a different level from the price a swing launched off, and substituting one for the other is precisely the 'the name looked right' failure this curation exists to prevent. The play itself concedes the reference is not even a single number ('the shelf is a zone, not a tick'). Its health field confirms the play is refine-only on the current architecture, and records that the one time a blind did fire it (0227) it fired at a shelf price had already broken through.

EVERY ARM'S OPERAND IS UNSERVED, INCLUDING THE REFERENCE THE BAR IS MEASURED AGAINST. The ARM needs swing amplitude as a ratio to 'the season's prior largest swing' (>=~1.5-2x), run length in sessions (>=~9) and a close >=~30% off the intraday extreme. The CONFIRM needs C1 (the counter day's net breaking its condition-class counter band by >=~1.5x), C2 (old-direction leg continuation <=~15%, big legs <=~1/3 alive), C3 (a pure sequencing rule - 'printed, never front-run' - which carries no bar at all) and C4 (the direction the next scheduled print delivers). None of swing amplitude, run length, close-off-extreme, leg-continuation rate or arbiter-print direction is in the vocabulary. C1 is the sharpest case and it fails twice: its operand (the prior day's realized net) is price content frozen under the mask, and its REFERENCE - the condition-class counter-band table - is, in the play's own health field, 'not served as a numeric table anywhere - each specialist re-derives them', so there is no value to compare against and any absolute dollar figure I wrote would be invented. The health field's verdict is unambiguous: under the mask C1 is 'permanently UNKNOWN - never true, never false'. That is exactly the state a curated condition must never be allowed to fake.

THE NUMBERS ARE THE PLAY'S OUTPUT, NOT ITS CONDITION. Every figure in the record is an expected day-net dollar band (-2400..-2900 chained crash, -1800..-4000 print-liquidity crash, +800..+1900 exhausted-leg bounce, -2000..-2800 liquidation flush, and so on) - the emission, not a quantity read at the open and compared to a bar. Writing one as a state_path threshold would assert the forecaster can read its own answer before the session. The play's actual gate is 'after a confirmed polarity flip (crash chain / basing)', which is structure.chain_polarity_flip's OUTPUT and is itself unserved for the reasons given on that play; and the six condition classes ('flip-confirm + chained crash', 'print-liquidity crash', 'exhausted-leg bounce'...) are day-class descriptors with no served quantity behind any of them. The audit adds the reason this matters rather than being a technicality: the play fired six times in G12 entirely OUTSIDE its stated regime, which is what an ungated trigger looks like.

THE PRICE BAR'S OPERAND IS UNSERVED, AND THE FLOW SUBSTITUTE - WHICH IS NOW SERVED - CARRIES NO BAR. The written bar is the prior day's counter-chain intraday spike measured against its close ('closes >=~60% off the counter extreme'), which is intraday price-path content: the vocabulary has no intraday peak, no close, no round-trip fraction. vol_regime.n0_prev_range and n0_prev_net cannot reconstruct it (a signed, polarity-relative peak-to-close fraction is not recoverable from an unsigned session range plus a net, it would need two paths combined into a ratio the schema cannot express, and in the blind state both are frozen at the anchor vintage and constant across the block). CORRECTION TO THE PREVIOUS PASS, AND THE ONE PLACE THE NEW VOCABULARY CHANGES THE FACTS: the declared FLOW substitute (E's 0528 read of phase_signed_flow [+112, +1684, -3762] against phase_b_share [0.483, 0.475, 0.430]) IS now served - tape_conditions.phase_signed_flow[0..2] and phase_b_share[0..2] are legal paths, having previously been excluded as indexed list paths. I re-derived on that and it is still no_condition, for a different reason than servedness: NO THRESHOLD FOR THE FLOW FORM IS WRITTEN ANYWHERE. The ~60% bar belongs to the price round-trip; E called its substitute 'failed_rally_tell in flow terms' with no bar, and the only other user (A, on 0619, '109% phase flow round-trip') withdrew it in writing with an explicit 'do not bank this'. Writing phase_signed_flow[2] < 0 would be manufacturing a sign test in place of a 60% bar, on a quantity the play's own falsifier says may be 'a different play wearing its name'. The health field names the underlying defect: in blind mode the fade percentage was taken off the forecaster's own GUESSED curve, so 'this play does not have an input; it has a mirror'.
